source.title_on_document: Autonomous language-image generation loops converge to generic visual motifs

paper_design_summary: A model-only simulation with no human participants. The authors build closed loops in which an image model (SDXL) draws an image from a text prompt and a vision-language model (LLaVA) describes the image, and the description becomes the next prompt. They run 700 trajectories (100 novelty-search start prompts x 7 temperatures, 100 iterations each) and a second experiment crossing 4 image generators with 4 captioning models (40 start prompts each), and measure semantic drift and convergence with sentence-embedding cosine distances and k-means clustering of final prompts.

studies.label: AI-to-AI text-image-text loops (temperature experiment and generator x captioner experiment)

assignment.what_was_assigned: No people. Model configurations (sampling temperature; image generator x captioning model) were varied across simulated trajectories.
assignment.quote: Across 700 trajectories with diverse starting prompts and 7 temperature settings over 100 iterations, all runs converged to nearly identical visuals
assignment.locator: PDF p. 2 (printed p. 1), Summary; PDF p. 11 (printed p. 10), Methods, Iterative language-image loop construction

participants.who: No human participants. Units are 700 simulated trajectories in the temperature experiment and 16 model combinations x 40 start prompts in the second experiment.
participants.quote: experiments were conducted across seven temperature values: 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, and 1.3. Each trajectory evolved through 100 prompt-image-prompt cycles.
participants.locator: PDF p. 11 (printed p. 10), Methods, Iterative language-image loop construction

ai_tool.name_model: Stable Diffusion XL and LLaVA (llava:13b); second experiment also segmind-SSD-1B, stable-diffusion-v1.5, playground-v2-aesthetic, bakllava, llava:13b-v1.6, moondream; initial prompts from LLaMA 3.2; embeddings from all-MiniLM-L6-v2
ai_tool.how_used: Models generate and describe images in an autonomous loop with no human input.

task.description: Iterated image generation from a prompt and image description (50 words or fewer) back into a prompt.

eligibility.reason: Model-only study: AI systems generate and describe images in closed loops with no human participants, no assignment of people to AI help, and no human-produced output (PDF p. 2 Summary; PDF p. 11 Methods). Model-only studies are listed in the screening report and omitted from the dataset (codebook section 3).

one_line_finding: In 700 autonomous SDXL-LLaVA loops run for 100 iterations, final prompts pooled into k = 12 clusters (temperature-specific k of 14 to 19 in the figure legend; PDF p. 8, Figure 5), and in the generator x captioner experiment the captioning model explained about 13.6 percent of the variance in step-to-step drift (F = 33.242, df 3, p < 10^-19) against 0.2 percent for the image generator (F = 0.534, p = 0.659) (PDF p. 6 text; PDF p. 11, Table 1).
notes: No human participants, so arms and outcomes are left empty. PDF page numbers run one ahead of the printed page numbers (PDF p. 1 is the cover page). Machine-only measures reported: cumulative cosine distance from the initial prompt (low temperatures about 0.85, high about 0.87; PDF p. 4 text, PDF p. 6 Figure 3A), step-to-step cosine distance (about 0.13 low vs 0.22 high temperature; PDF p. 4 text, PDF p. 6 Figure 3B), k-means elbow cluster counts (PDF p. 4 text, PDF p. 8 Figure 5), two-way ANOVA (PDF p. 11, Table 1: image generator SS 0.0149, df 3, F 0.534, p 0.659; language model SS 0.9247, df 3, F 33.242, p < 10^-19; A x B SS 0.0520, df 9, F 0.623, p 0.778; residual SS 5.786, df 624). Inconsistency inside the paper: the text says temperature-specific optimal clusters range from 15 to 20 (PDF p. 4; PDF p. 6 says k = 15-20), while the Figure 5 legend lists k_opt = 16, 18, 19, 14, 16, 17, 17 for t = 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 0.9, 1.1, 1.3 (PDF p. 8).
